_README: Live probe of the only two AIAIC sources that are BOTH verified_live AND keyless network calls. Captured to answer whether they are genuinely accessible at runtime, rather than asserting it.
_classification: LIVE - real external third-party APIs, no key, no Group 3 hardware
_honesty: Neither source is Group 3 hardware evidence. Neither is satellite imagery. AIAIC does hold ISRO AWiFS/OCM2 rasters, but they are annual offline snapshots, not a live feed. Any observation built from these must carry the external source identity and attribution, and must NOT be classified PHYSICAL.

sources.kind: live weather API - forecast model output, updated continuously
sources.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC-BY 4.0), aggregating national weather services. Non-commercial free tier.

sources.kind: satellite- and model-DERIVED observational agroclimatology, 2-3 day latency. NOT satellite imagery and NOT a forecast.
sources.attribution: These data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project (power.larc.nasa.gov). Free and open; cite the NASA POWER Project.
